== Published English Original Virtual Set 4 wording ==
The original explicitly targets one opponent character and grants cancellation for the rest of the turn. The later slip permits cancellation during battle with the piloted AT-AT and omits the expressed duration. The source establishes that wording distinction; it does not supply a new general duration ruling.
